analytical_boundaries: Event action locations are not continuous standing positions.
A whole-match passing network can combine substitutions and tactical changes; published example uses first-half minutes10-40.
Tracking occupancy describes detected positions, with coverage limits; it does not by itself identify a tactical role.
Community explanations supply research questions; independently observed data determines which claims are supported.
